analysis.one_line_summary: A Lebanese creator tests how fast she can achieve a salon-quality blowout at home using the WavyTalk Blowout Boost heated round brush.
analysis.full_description: A creator wearing a blue buttoned dress times her blowout routine at home using the pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush. She starts by setting a timer on her wristwatch, then sections her long dark hair, showing step-by-step how she lifts at the roots, glides with light tension, and rolls out. After showing the first section result, she styles the rest of her hair, checks the watch timer, reveals the final voluminous bouncy hair, highlights the tool's 30-second heat-up time, and concludes with a 20% off offer and call to action.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: قديه بتقولي بدي وقت لاعمل full blowout بالبيت؟ خليني فرجيكي.
transcript.text_english: How long do you think I need to do a full blowout at home? Let me show you.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_english: First thing, we set the timer.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: رح بلش بالـ section يلي فوق لاعمل أكتر volume. باخد خصلة صغيرة، برفعها لفوق وبحط الـ brush تحت الـ roots.
transcript.text_english: I'll start with the top section to get more volume. I take a small section, lift it up and place the brush under the roots.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: لاعمل maximum volume، بضل مرق الـ brush directly لتحت، بلفها لورا تـ تلف الخصلة حولها، وبخليها كم ثانية عند الـ roots.
transcript.text_english: To get maximum volume, I glide the brush directly down, roll it back so the hair wraps around it, and keep it a few seconds at the roots.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: وانا وعم مرق الـ brush، بحافظ على tension خفيفة، بمرقها شوي شوي عطول الخصلة وبلف، واخر شي لبرا قبل ما شيلها عن الخصلة.
transcript.text_english: While gliding the brush, I maintain gentle tension, passing it slowly along the strand and rolling, and finally curling outward before releasing it.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: شوفوا الفرق قديه طلع حلو، الـ roots اخدوا lift، والخصلة صار فيها shape و bounce.
transcript.text_english: Look at how nice the difference turned out, the roots got a lift, and the strand has shape and bounce.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: وهلا رح استعمل نفس الـ technique على باقي شعري. بلف الـ brush ع الخصلة مع tension خفيفة، وباخد خصل صغيرة كرمال يبين شعري open و bouncy وفيه volume.
transcript.text_english: And now I will use the same technique on the rest of my hair. I wrap the brush around the strand with gentle tension, taking small sections so my hair looks open, bouncy, and full of volume.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_english: And now let's stop the timer.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: انتو بس شوفولي قديه طلع الـ result حلو! الـ tool يلي عم بستعملها هي WavyTalk Blowout Boost.
transcript.text_english: Just look at how gorgeous the result turned out! The tool I'm using is the WavyTalk Blowout Boost.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: نقيتها لانها بتحمى بس بـ 30 ثانية، بقدر زبط شعري كله بنفس الـ brush، وهيدا اللي بيخليني خلص أسرع وبطريقة اسهل.
transcript.text_english: I chose it because it heats up in just 30 seconds, I can do all my hair with the same brush, and this is what lets me finish faster and much easier.

transcript.speaker: creator
transcript.text_original: واذا انتي كمان بدك هيدا الـ volume بشعرك، اطلبي الـ WavyTalk Blowout Boost بـ 20% off.
transcript.text_english: And if you also want this volume in your hair, order the WavyTalk Blowout Boost at 20% off.

analysis.transcript_full_english: How long do you think I need to do a full blowout at home? Let me show you. First thing, we set the timer. I'll start with the top section to get more volume. I take a small section, lift it up and place the brush under the roots. To get maximum volume, I glide the brush directly down, roll it back so the hair wraps around it, and keep it a few seconds at the roots. While gliding the brush, I maintain gentle tension, passing it slowly along the strand and rolling, and finally curling outward before releasing it. Look at how nice the difference turned out, the roots got a lift, and the strand has shape and bounce. And now I will use the same technique on the rest of my hair. I wrap the brush around the strand with gentle tension, taking small sections so my hair looks open, bouncy, and full of volume. And now let's stop the timer. Just look at how gorgeous the result turned out! The tool I'm using is the WavyTalk Blowout Boost. I chose it because it heats up in just 30 seconds, I can do all my hair with the same brush, and this is what lets me finish faster and much easier. And if you also want this volume in your hair, order the WavyTalk Blowout Boost at 20% off.
